children: Arakyd's BT-16 Perimeter Security Droid is a walking Guard Droid that resembles a large, thin-legged spider. These Droids were originally designed for basic perimeter defense around private estates and government compounds, although many find their ways into the hands of criminals who used the BT-16s to protect their dens of illegal activity. These Droids are extremely stable and have the ability to climb over low objects and even up vertical surfaces. The BT-16 reacts quickly against intruders, and it can unleash a torrent of blaster fire.
